style_name: Extreme Survival Physiology (2D Cinematic Storybook Stickman)

acts.name: The Paradox Hook
acts.goal: Begin at the biological tipping point: the moment blood shunts inward or oxygen saturation plunges. An eerie paradox of the human body.

acts.name: The Fragile Routine
acts.goal: The solitary explorer stickman enduring the quiet routine in extreme terrain, unaware of the subtle biological cascade beginning.

acts.name: The Biological Domino
acts.goal: Microscopic breakdown of physiological failure: cellular glycolysis, vasoconstriction, paradoxical undressing, alveolar collapse step by step.

acts.name: The Cold Epilogue
acts.goal: The haunting quiet of human survival limits, forensic autopsy deductions, and the terrifying biological boundary between life and death.

flow.character_guide: Minimalist stickman explorer character with smooth off-white round head, simple black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, wearing a thick heavy fur-trimmed parka jacket with realistic cloth drape folds
flow.look: Wide 2D cinematic storybook illustration, hand-painted matte digital art, European graphic novel aesthetic (bande dessinée / ligne claire), uncluttered composition, generous negative space, atmospheric depth. Minimalist stickman explorer character with smooth off-white round head, shivering simple black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, wearing a thick heavy fur-trimmed parka jacket with realistic cloth drape folds, holding a warm glowing copper hurricane lantern. Environment: dusk snow mountain ridge, gentle whisper of blowing snow fog, warm golden lantern light casting long shadows across untouched blue snow. Single continuous 16:9 widescreen frame. Single camera view. Absolutely NO comic book panels, NO multi-panel grids, NO split screens, NO borders.

editorial.voice: Cold, clinical, yet intensely intimate medical-investigative narrator. Speaks in a calm, lowered register with deliberate silent pauses when core body temperature drops by a single decimal. Never rushes. Deadpan observational delivery with zero panic.
rules: Micro-substance: cite cellular chemistry, core temperature thresholds in Celsius/Fahrenheit, milliequivalents of electrolyte shift, and heart rate decelerations.
Visceral sensory reality: the metallic taste of severe hypoxia, the silent numbness of freezing nerve fibers, the deceptive warmth of terminal paradoxical undressing.
Analogies: compare metabolic heat dissipation to a leaking radiator, arterial constriction to a closed river dam.
4-Act structure: The Paradox Hook -> The Fragile Routine -> The Biological Domino -> The Cold Epilogue.
